rationale: Background is 0 and mode is 0: each nonzero input cell selects a copy of the full input. In the first demonstration, the top-right 1 selects a copy while the two top-left zeros select blank blocks; the 3 and 2 demonstrations follow the same rule.

Background is 0 and mode is 1: each zero input cell selects a copy of the full input. In the first demonstration, copies occur at the four zero positions and the all-2 bottom row selects blank blocks. In the second, the all-zero middle row selects three copies; the third likewise copies only at zeros.
